prompt.intro: Set up iconic MCP and the av-schematic skill, then help me operate the AV canvas.
prompt.folder: Download the pack and extract it to a permanent folder. Confirm its absolute path; never assume a developer machine path.
prompt.install:
INSTALLATION
1. Requires Node.js 22.20+, npm and the selected AI client. The pack bundles MCP dependencies; npm install is only needed for a source checkout.
2. Run these commands from the extracted iconic-agent-pack folder:
prompt.generic: Merge the printed mcpServers JSON into the client configuration without replacing other entries. For the skill, use npx skills@1.7.4 add . --skill av-schematic -a <supported-agent-id> -g --copy. Verify the client agent ID first.
prompt.after:
3. --with-skill installs via Vercel skills and requires internet. A skill and MCP registration are separate.
4. Preserve existing MCP registrations. Use --replace only if I explicitly request replacing this app’s old entry.
5. Keep iconic open and reload the AI client. The installer performs a read-only connection check. Exit code 2 means settings may be saved but the connection is unverified; do not claim success until verified.
6. Keep the extracted pack at the same absolute path after registration.
prompt.skill:
SKILL
Read skills/av-schematic/SKILL.md and its references/setup.md and references/tools.md as needed. In Codex, ask to use $av-schematic. If the client has no skill support, treat the file as instructions. Skill-only installation:
prompt.rules:
RULES
Read list_devices first, and get_room for 3D work. Preserve the current drawing; delete or clear only when I explicitly ask. Create zones, then devices, then cables. Use exact tags and port labels; assign signal types. Reuse tags across schematic, rack and room. Room units are metres. Batch commands are sequential; after a failure reread state before retrying, since applied commands remain. Control only the local canvas; never expose its endpoint publicly.
prompt.exports: JSON projects and PNG/SVG/PDF/HTML/XLSX exports are manual app features, outside the 15 MCP tools.
prompt.report: Report actual installation and connection results, the loaded skill, available tools, device and cable counts. Do not edit the canvas after setup; wait for my system requirements.
